paper_title: Predictions for Axion Couplings from ALP Cogenesis
suggested_experiment_name: CAST2017 (with HB stars at high mass)
notes: Theory paper predicting ALP couplings (photon, nucleon, electron) as functions of mass from a cogenesis mechanism. It presents theoretical prediction bands (e.g. |g_agamma| ~ 1.8e-11 GeV^-1 * caγγ * (ma/meV)^1/2), NOT a new experimental exclusion limit or an experiment-specific sensitivity projection. Existing constraints (CAST, ADMX, HB stars, etc.) are only reproduced from other works. No new measured limit to extract. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 1 (fig_02.png) shows g_agamma vs m_a. All other lines (ALPs-II, BabyIAXO, IAXO, DM Radio, ADMX, MADMAX, ABRACADABRA-75cm, KLASH, CULTASK) are future-sensitivity projections, not exclusions.
